project.description: Uploads one Terraform env template for the selected service. Each service has a single template shared by both stacks; a change takes effect the next time that service renders and deploys.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: SERVICE
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Service whose Terraform env template should be uploaded.

hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.name: service.env.tftpl
hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.description: Non-empty Terraform env template for the selected service. It is stored under that service's canonical filename.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" shopt -s nullglob for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [[ -f "$script_file" && -x "$script_file" ]]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done shopt -u nullglob
for fn in assume_role reset_role; do if ! command -v "$fn" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: required function '$fn' was not loaded from $source_scripts_folder." >&2 exit 1 fi done
: "${SERVICE:?SERVICE is required}" : "${stack_s3_bucket:?stack_s3_bucket is required}"
case "$SERVICE" in Gateway) template_file="gateway.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/gateway/templates" ;; Operations) template_file="operations.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/operations/templates" ;; Query) template_file="query.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/query/templates" ;; "HPDS Auth") template_file="hpds-auth.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/hpds/templates" ;; "HPDS Open") template_file="hpds-open.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/hpds/templates" ;; Visualization) template_file="visualization.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/pic-sure-visualization/templates" ;; Logging) template_file="logging.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/pic-sure-logging/templates" ;; Dictionary) template_file="picsure-dictionary.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/picsure-dictionary/templates" ;; *) echo "Error: unsupported SERVICE selection." >&2 exit 1 ;; esac
upload_file="service.env.tftpl" if [[ ! -f "$upload_file" || ! -s "$upload_file" ]]; then echo "Error: $upload_file is missing or empty; refusing to upload." >&2 exit 1 fi
destination="s3://$stack_s3_bucket/$template_prefix/$template_file" echo "Uploading $template_file to $destination."
trap 'reset_role' EXIT assume_role aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "$upload_file" "$destination"
